articles.content: Summary Microsoft's October 2026 Patch Tuesday arrived with CVE-2026-96951 , an exploited zero-day in the Microsoft Windows Shell that lets an attacker strip the Mark of the Web (MotW) from a malicious file — making an internet download look like a trusted local file.
